content.short: KuCoin is a global centralized exchange providing high liquidity and a wide range of trading pairs for TON.
content.description: KuCoin is one of the world's leading centralized cryptocurrency exchanges, known for its extensive range of listed assets and high trading volume. It provides a robust platform for trading Toncoin (TON) and various other tokens within the TON ecosystem against major pairings like USDT and BTC. With its user-friendly interface, advanced trading features, and strong security measures, KuCoin serves as a primary gateway for millions of users to buy, sell, and manage their TON holdings with ease and confidence.
